  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenReader is our fast-growing consumer audio app, and creative is one of our biggest growth levers. We’re looking for a Creative Producer to deliver creative marketing campaigns, experiments, and to build the creative engine that powers performance marketing across every major acquisition channel.

This role sits at the intersection of creative design, AI, and performance marketing. You’ll be our lead creative strategist, producing high-quality creative concepts, building scalable creative workflows using AI tools, developing a testing roadmap, launching experiments across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms with our Performance Marketing team. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Design, Growth Analytics, and partner agencies to continuously discover which creative drives acquisition at scale, and feeding these insights back into future creative roadmaps.

This is one part strategist and one part creative producer for someone who loves combining exceptional creative taste with rigorous experimentation and marketing results.

What you will do

  • Designing creative systems, concepts and templates, mood boards, briefs, and AI workflows that power high-velocity ad production

  • Create visually-stunning, brand aligned, static ad campaigns end-to-end in Figma and ElevenLabs

  • Directing agency partners with clear and compelling creative briefs, UGC scripts, storyboards, scripts, and feedback on creative concepts, ensuring the timely and aligned delivery of assets

  • Creating and launching creative testing programs across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging acquisition channels with Performance Marketing and agencies

  • Developing a structured creative roadmap with recurring testing sprints and clear learning agendas

  • Designing analytical frameworks to identify winning creative patterns using performance data and creative analysis

  • Researching and mapping creative trends across competitors, consumer categories, and best-in-class mobile apps to generate new hypotheses for testing

  • Partnering closely with Performance Marketing and agencies to rapidly iterate and scale winning campaigns

  • Continuously improving our creative production pipeline through AI automation, reusable templates, and scalable workflows

  • Analyzing which creative is resonating most with our audience through ad platforms and tools like Motion

  • Raising the creative quality bar while ensuring every asset is designed to maximize measurable business outcomes

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in performance creative, art direction, growth marketing, creative strategy, or design at a high-growth consumer product or technology company

  • Deep expertise with generative AI for image and video creation, with a strong understanding of how to build repeatable creative workflows with tools like ElevenCreative

  • Experience creating high-performing ads across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, or other major paid acquisition platforms

  • Experience with creative performance analytics tools like Motion

  • Strong understanding of creative experimentation, performance marketing, A/B testing, and data-driven optimization

  • Expert proficiency in Figma, CapCut, Adobe Suite and modern AI creative tools and generative media platforms

  • Exceptional visual taste with the ability to balance speed, quality, and brand consistency

  • Deep understanding of user psychology and what drives successful consumer marketing

  • Highly analytical and structured thinker who enjoys building experimentation frameworks and extracting insights from data

  • Self-directed builder who thrives in fast-moving environments and can independently take ideas from concept to launch

Bonus

  • Power user of ElevenCreative, including Flows and Templates

  • Background in building AI-powered creative production systems or internal creative tooling

  • Passion for consumer products, AI, storytelling, and building globally loved brands.

Location

This role is remote with a preference for timezones in US - East and Europe


#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We’re building a dedicated Strategic Accounts team to own ElevenLabs’ most important customer relationships in North America, and we’re looking for a high-impact Strategic Account Executive to be among the first hires.

This is a named-account role with a focused portfolio. You'll drive new business and expansion inside complex enterprise organizations, building multi-threaded executive relationships and positioning yourself as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders navigating real transformation - across customer experience, product, and operations.

These aren't transactional engagements. You'll architect custom solutions that combine our technology and services, collaborate cross-functionally to deliver measurable outcomes, and bring field intelligence directly into our product roadmap. You're not just executing a playbook - you're writing it.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic accounts, driving both net-new business and expansion

  • Develop and execute multi-year account strategies across business units, geographies, and use cases

  • Identify, scope, and close large, complex deals (multi-product, multi-region, custom solutions)

  • Build deep, multi-threaded relationships across executive, product, engineering, and business stakeholders

  • Act as a strategic advisor, educating on emerging trends and shaping customers’ long-term AI roadmap

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships to deliver and expand

  • Translate patterns from bespoke deals into repeatable frameworks, offerings, and product insights

  • Feed learnings from the field into the product roadmap and broader strategic sales playbook

  • Drive creative outbound and high-touch engagement strategies (onsites, exec briefings, events)

Requirements

  • 6-10+ years of quota-carrying experience with a focus on strategic / enterprise accounts

  • Proven track record of closing and expanding seven-figure+ deals within named accounts

  • Experience leading complex, multi-threaded sales cycles across large organizations

  • Strong ability to drive land-and-expand motions and long-term account growth

  • Experience scoping consultative, custom deals that go beyond standard SKUs

  • Technical fluency - able to engage product and engineering leaders on APIs, integrations, and architecture

  • Executive presence with the ability to influence C-suite stakeholders and long-term strategy

  • Track record of translating customer needs into product feedback and roadmap influence

  • Creative, self-driven approach to outbound and pipeline generation

  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, ambiguous environment, building playbooks from scratch

  • Willingness to travel for customer engagements (onsites, QBRs, executive meetings)

  • Strong bias toward action, ownership, and leveraging AI in day-to-day workflows

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role
You’ll build the tools that make Studio a video editor people want to live in. These include transitions, color grading and elements libraries all built on top of our in-house engine. You’ll also build presets, so a user can get the effect they want without tweaking 20 individual controls.
The work mixes greenfield features with polish on the existing editor. An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’ll write proposals, get fast feedback, and own features through launch, including the marketing moment.
You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required.


Requirements

  • Strong frontend engineer who has built complex, interactive UIs.

  • Enough full-stack ability to work across the stack, but deep backend expertise isn’t needed.

  • Evidence of product responsibility: side projects, open source, or product-facing work.

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, startup-style environment, and takes ownership with minimal hand-holding.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

As the PE & Growth Investor Partnerships at ElevenLabs, you will build and scale one of our most strategic growth channels. You will own relationships with leading PE & Growth Investor firms, embed ElevenLabs into their Enterprise Value Creation programs, and drive AI adoption across portfolio companies.

Operating at the intersection of PE, Growth Investors, enterprise AI, & GTM, you will partner with Operating Partners, Value Creation teams, portfolio executives, and our Sales organization to source, accelerate, and close opportunities. You’ll work closely with the Global Head of BD & Partnerships & all regional GTM leads to define the strategy while owning execution across multiple PE & Growth Investor relationships.

Your success will be measured by your ability to build a scalable investor partner ecosystem that consistently generates enterprise pipeline and ARR.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 - 9 months, you will:

  • Launch the ElevenLabs Private Equity & Growth Investor Partner Program.

  • Recruit and activate 8–10 leading PE and growth investor partners, securing ElevenLabs’ inclusion in their Value Creation and portfolio engagement programs.

  • Build a repeatable GTM engagement model between investor operating teams and ElevenLabs to accelerate portfolio company adoption, pipeline generation, and deal velocity.

  • Establish a foundation for a scalable, partner-sourced ARR business.

Responsibilities

Private Equity & Growth Investor Partnerships

  • Build and manage executive relationships with Operating Partners, Value Creation leaders, and investment professionals across leading PE & Growth investor firms.

  • Structure and negotiate partnership agreements, joint GTM plans, referral models, and enterprise value programs.

  • Become the trusted AI partner for PE firms looking to accelerate value creation across their portfolio.

Portfolio Company Activation

  • Identify high-priority portfolio companies and develop joint account plans with PE operating teams.

  • Coordinate with Enterprise AEs, FDEs, Customer Success, and Product to drive AI deployments from initial introduction through production.

  • Help portfolio companies identify high-value AI use cases and accelerate adoption.

Pipeline & Revenue

  • Own pipeline generation and ARR sourced through PE partnerships.

  • Build and maintain a rolling portfolio company pipeline across assigned sponsors.

  • Drive executive introductions, accelerate deal velocity, and expand successful deployments across additional portfolio companies.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Success to execute PE opportunities.

  • Develop repeatable GTM playbooks, executive engagement models, and portfolio-wide AI adoption frameworks.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at PE conferences, operating partner forums, and executive events.

You May Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have 8–12+ years of experience in Enterprise AI, Cloud, or enterprise software, with a focus on strategic partnerships involving Private Equity and Growth Investors.

  • Have experience working with PE firms, Growth Investors, Operating Partners, Value Creation teams, or PE-backed portfolio companies.

  • Have a track record of building strategic partnerships that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.

  • Have strong executive presence and can engage credibly with Managing Partners, Operating Partners, CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, and investment professionals.

  • Have successfully navigated complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Are comfortable discussing AI platforms and enterprise technology with both business and technical audiences.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoy building new partnership motions from the ground up.

  • Are highly commercial, operate with urgency, and consistently create opportunities where none previously existed.

Location

This role is remote-first but NYC or London is preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the Role

As Mid-Market Lead, you will be the strategic driver behind scaling and optimizing our Mid-Market AE organization in the Eastern US. You’ll own revenue outcomes and team performance across our Mid-Market segment, with a strong focus on building repeatable, high-velocity sales motions. This role blends hands-on leadership with strategic execution in a fast-growing environment.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for U.S. Mid-Market accounts, including quotas, segmentation, and territory design.

  • Lead, coach, and scale a team of Mid-Market AEs, owning recruiting, onboarding, enablement, and performance management.

  • Own pipeline health and forecasting, driving consistency and improving conversion rates across each stage of the funnel.

  • Develop and refine sales playbooks, motions, objection frameworks, and deal models tailored to Mid-Market buyers and voice AI / conversational use cases.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Growth, and Customer Success to align positioning, messaging, and expansion opportunities.

  • Establish feedback loops by synthesizing insights from prospects and customers to help inform GTM strategy and product roadmap decisions.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of SaaS or technology sales experience, with meaningful experience leading or scaling Mid-Market AE teams.

  • Demonstrated success surpassing revenue targets in a Mid-Market or velocity-oriented sales environment.

  • Strong command of sales metrics, funnel optimization, forecasting, and process rigor.

  • Experience selling technical, AI, or API-driven solutions to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence across teams and seniority levels.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with high ownership.

Location

This role is remote-first, however the ability to operate in EST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York, with the option to work out of our office.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the DACH region

  • Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Proven experience working across the DACH market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances

  • Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

  • Strong builder mindset - you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes

  • Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs

  • Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams

  • Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities along with renewals

  • Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Germany, Austria, or Switzerland.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

ElevenMusic is our consumer-facing music creation platform, built for music creators and professional musicians alike. We want ElevenMusic to have a voice, a community, and a content presence that matches the ambition of the product.

We are looking for a Content Creator & Strategist to own that presence. You will make music with the platform every day, push it to its limits, and turn what you discover into educational content, tutorials, and social posts that teach creators what's possible. You will own the ElevenMusic social accounts, build and energise the community around the product, and represent ElevenMusic on stage at creator events.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of music creation, content, and community. The right person is a genuine music maker who lives on social platforms, has strong opinions about how an AI music brand should show up, and is just as comfortable behind a mic or on stage as they are in an editing timeline. Because you'll be using the product harder than almost anyone, you'll also be a critical feedback loop into the engineering team, shaping the product itself.

What you will do

  • Create educational content and tutorial videos around ElevenMusic — recording, editing, and formatting them natively for each platform and publishing them across our socials

  • Make music with ElevenMusic constantly, testing the platform to its limits and turning experiments into content that shows creators what's possible

  • Provide structured, high-signal product feedback to the engineering team based on deep daily use, helping shape the roadmap

  • Own and manage the ElevenMusic social accounts, from content calendar and strategy through to publishing, engagement, and analytics

  • Help build and grow a community around ElevenMusic, sparking conversation, surfacing creator feedback, and championing standout work

  • Speak at creator events, representing ElevenMusic through talks, demos, and workshops

  • Plan and execute content around product launches and feature releases, coordinating with product, engineering, and marketing teams

  • Stay ahead of trends in music creation, AI tools, and platform culture to find opportunities for the brand

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience creating content, with a portfolio of work you can share

  • Proven ability to produce educational content and tutorial videos end-to-end: recording, editing, adding text and motion, and formatting natively for platforms like X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

  • Experience managing social media accounts for a technology, music, or creative tools company, including content calendars, copywriting, and analytics

  • Comfortable presenting publicly — speaking at events, running demos or workshops, and being a visible face for the product

  • A genuine understanding of the AI and music creation landscape — you use the tools, follow the space, and have informed opinions about where things are headed

Bonus

  • Experience managing social for a music-related product

  • Experience running or growing a community channel such as Discord

  • Experience with social scheduling and management tools (Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar)

  • Experience building a social presence from early stage or leading a rebrand on social

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead social strategy across all ElevenLabs brands and sub-brands as the social function scales

  • Move into a broader content role spanning video, editorial, and social

  • Expand into brand marketing or creative direction as the growth team evolves

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

#LI-Remote

ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenMusic is our consumer-facing music creation platform, built for music creators and professional musicians alike. We want ElevenMusic to have a voice, a community, and a content presence that matches the ambition of the product.

We are looking for a Content Creator & Strategist to own that presence. You will make music with the platform every day, push it to its limits, and turn what you discover into educational content, tutorials, and social posts that teach creators what's possible. You will own the ElevenMusic social accounts, build and energise the community around the product, and represent ElevenMusic on stage at creator events.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of music creation, content, and community. The right person is a genuine music maker who lives on social platforms, has strong opinions about how an AI music brand should show up, and is just as comfortable behind a mic or on stage as they are in an editing timeline. Because you'll be using the product harder than almost anyone, you'll also be a critical feedback loop into the engineering team, shaping the product itself.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Create educational content and tutorial videos around ElevenMusic — recording, editing, and formatting them natively for each platform and publishing them across our socials

 - Make music with ElevenMusic constantly, testing the platform to its limits and turning experiments into content that shows creators what's possible

 - Provide structured, high-signal product feedback to the engineering team based on deep daily use, helping shape the roadmap

 - Own and manage the ElevenMusic social accounts, from content calendar and strategy through to publishing, engagement, and analytics

 - Help build and grow a community around ElevenMusic, sparking conversation, surfacing creator feedback, and championing standout work

 - Speak at creator events, representing ElevenMusic through talks, demos, and workshops

 - Plan and execute content around product launches and feature releases, coordinating with product, engineering, and marketing teams

 - Stay ahead of trends in music creation, AI tools, and platform culture to find opportunities for the brand




REQUIREMENTS

 - Demonstrated experience creating content, with a portfolio of work you can share

 - Proven ability to produce educational content and tutorial videos end-to-end: recording, editing, adding text and motion, and formatting natively for platforms like X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

 - Experience managing social media accounts for a technology, music, or creative tools company, including content calendars, copywriting, and analytics

 - Comfortable presenting publicly — speaking at events, running demos or workshops, and being a visible face for the product

 - A genuine understanding of the AI and music creation landscape — you use the tools, follow the space, and have informed opinions about where things are headed


BONUS

 - Experience managing social for a music-related product

 - Experience running or growing a community channel such as Discord

 - Experience with social scheduling and management tools (Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar)

 - Experience building a social presence from early stage or leading a rebrand on social


GROWTH POTENTIAL

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

 - Lead social strategy across all ElevenLabs brands and sub-brands as the social function scales

 - Move into a broader content role spanning video, editorial, and social

 - Expand into brand marketing or creative direction as the growth team evolves


LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

  1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Poland, with a primary focus on Financial Services & Insurance, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for financial services institutions.

  1. 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  2. Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  3. Well-connected in the Polish financial services landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  4. Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  5. Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Poland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  6. Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  7. Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  8. A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

  9. Native or full professional proficiency in Polish; strong English for internal collaboration.

About the role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in LATAM Southern Cone. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

As our first marketing hire in LATAM Southern Cone, your work will shape how Southern Cone businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

 

What you'll do

  • Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Southern Cone priority industries — from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

  • Own field marketing for the region: plan and run self-hosted events (dinners, roundtables, workshops), represent ElevenLabs at third-party conferences and sponsorships, and bring in creative, high-touch formats (experiential activations, executive dinners, partner co-hosted sessions) that build pipeline and brand with technical buyers.

  • Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound — choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

  • Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Southern Cone market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

  • Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

  • Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

 

Requirements

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our Legal Team in India. In this role, you will support complex commercial transactions across India and where necessary, the broader APAC region, including SaaS, licensing, and strategic partnerships, while helping the company navigate diverse legal and regulatory frameworks in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. You will work closely with global colleagues to provide practical, business-oriented advice that enables growth while managing risk across multiple jurisdictions.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, with a primary focus on GTM/Sales transactions in India, including enterprise customer contracts

  • Partner with sales, business development, and operations teams to design and implement strategies that support high-growth go-to-market initiatives.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving region specific legal and regulatory developments, including data protection, technology, and AI-related frameworks, and apply this knowledge to contract drafting and risk assessment.

  • Develop, maintain, and localize contract templates, playbooks, and policies to reflect regional requirements and industry best practices.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused legal advice to cross-functional teams, tailoring advice to enable responsible growth and innovation.

  • Contribute to scaling the Legal Team’s commercial function, fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.

Who you are

  • Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • Have worked for a US Based or Global multinational out of India but have direct experience working with customers both in and outside the region

  • Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues.

  • Proactive, business-minded, and committed to delivering practical solutions that support both compliance and commercial success.

  • Hunger to be exceptional at your job.

What you bring

  • Law degree and qualification to practice law in India

  • 7+ years of relevant post-qualification legal experience (in-house experience in technology or SaaS strongly preferred).

  • Proven track record drafting and negotiating complex commercial and technology agreements.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise software licensing, SaaS, data protection, and intellectual property.

  • Experience advising on privacy, cybersecurity, and cross-border data transfer issues.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and tight deadlines

Location

This role is remote, so it can be executed from anywhere in India. We’re particularly looking for candidates based in Bengalaru, Delhi, Chennai, Mumbai, Hyderabad.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

Productions is the 'done for you' managed services wing of ElevenLabs made for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts to unlock human-edited dubs, audiobooks, and more in 15+ languages directly on the ElevenLabs platform.

Here are a few recent projects Productions has helped bring to life:

  • Dubbing for some of the world's biggest creators (DudePerfect, Lex Fridman, Andrew Huberman), media businesses (Headspace) and broadcasters (Mediaset)

  • Audiobook production for leading publishers and digital storytelling platforms

  • Voice creation, sound design, and other audio engineering services for ElevenLabs' largest customers

  • You can learn more about Productions here: https://elevenlabs.io/productions

As an Audio Engineering & Post-Production Lead, you will:

  • Lead a team of talented Audio Engineers

  • Create, refine, and iterate on custom voices for ElevenLabs customer using different techniques

  • Clean, edit, and prepare customer audio to ensure optimal cloning and generation quality

  • Provide hands-on training and technical guidance on ElevenLabs tools and best practices

  • Join customer calls, support creative direction, and act as a fractional audio engineer for their workflows

Requirements

  • 10+ years experience in audio engineering, sound design, mixing/mastering, or related media fields

  • Experience working directly with clients, creative teams, or technical stakeholders

  • Strong proficiency with DAWs (e.g., Pro Tools, Reaper, Logic, Ableton)

  • Deep intuition for voice characteristics, timbre, clarity, and performance nuance

  • Ability to translate ambiguous customer needs into clear audio and voice-design solutions

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

About the role

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll work as part of a driven team to unlock the full potential of our voice AI platform for a growing customer base. Your mission is to efficiently scale our technical solutions to many enterprise customers, both directly and by improving our internal processes and supporting our sales teams.

As a Solutions Engineer, you can expect to:

  • Collaborate strategically with Account Executives to enhance the technical aspects of the sales process.

  • Work directly with technical contacts from our customers and prospective customers to provide bespoke support and architect solutions.

  • Craft compelling technical demonstrations that clearly communicate our product's value proposition.

  • Create technical enablement resources that amplify our sales team's effectiveness and technical fluency.

  • Build self-service tools and documentation that empower customers to implement solutions independently.

  • Identify opportunities to productize common integration patterns or features, and work with our product teams to make these real!

Requirements

We're looking for exceptional individuals who excel at working with customers on technical problems and excited to work with us to scale this efficiently. You'll thrive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

  • Enjoy working directly with customers, iterating on solutions and providing tailored support

  • Have a talent for identifying patterns that can be standardized and scaled.

  • Have strong empathy for customers, sales and product teams.

  • Have a strong technical background in order to help customers architect integration between our solutions and their existing solutions

  • Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

  • Proficiency in Python, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and common integration patterns.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences.

    Location

    This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Sweden, with a preference of Stockholm. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Swedish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact.

  • Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

  • Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap.

  • Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers.

  • Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience working with customers in a technical capacity. Direct enterprise customer experience is preferred.

  • Experience in product development, delivery, and change management

  • Commercial instinct: comfort engaging in deal conversations, structuring value propositions, and navigating enterprise sales cycles alongside GTM partners.

  • Basic proficiency in Python and familiarity with API integration, sufficient to prototype, demo, and communicate credibly with engineering teams.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; particularly the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and structure clear logic in pursuit of optimal solutions.

  • A proven track record of taking ownership of complex, ambiguous projects and delivering results.

  • Adaptability to work across different customer environments, industries, and technical use cases.

  • Technical aptitude and familiarity with common LLM, tooling and AI agent frameworks.

  • Ability to creatively map enterprise use cases and workflows to AI systems

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Sweden, with a preference of Stockholm. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Swedish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Poland's largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Government & Utilities. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Polish institutions — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Poland, with a primary focus on Government & Utilities, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  • Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency across Government & Utility institutions.

  • Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends.

  • Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

  • Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Polish Government sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  • Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  • Well-connected in the Polish Government and Utilities landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  • Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Poland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  • Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  • A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes customer satisfaction and scale.

  • Native or full professional proficiency in Polish; strong English for internal collaboration.

Location:

This is an in-country role with a preference for a candidate based in Warsaw.

#LI-remote

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs spends meaningfully on paid acquisition, and that spend is only as good as the data behind it. We are looking for an engineer to own our measurement layer end to end: the tag manager setup, the tracking and attribution scripts on our sites, and the server-to-server conversion tracking that feeds our ad platforms.

Day to day you will work closely with the paid marketing team: fixing tracking bugs as they come in, setting up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debugging discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data. Longer term, you will define how tracking should properly work here and build the monitoring so we catch breakage in hours, not weeks.

This role sits between frontend engineering, data engineering, and marketing. You will add and improve tracking scripts without hurting pagespeed, keep our server-side GTM container healthy, make sure consent and regional restrictions are correctly enforced, and ensure the right channels get credit for the right conversions. Your work directly decides how a large paid budget gets allocated.

What you will do

  • Own our tag manager setup end to end, including the server-side GTM container, and review any changes other teams want to make

  • Work with the paid marketing team daily: fix tracking bugs, set up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debug discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data

  • Build and maintain server-to-server conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, and similar) and validate pixel vs server deduplication

  • Improve tracking script performance and correctness, keeping script impact on pagespeed and Core Web Vitals within budget

  • Make sure consent handling and regional restrictions are correctly enforced across markets

  • Define event schema and UTM conventions, and document them so tracking for new campaigns is correct by default

  • Build monitoring and alerting for the measurement stack so we catch broken tracking within hours, not weeks

  • Review PRs that add conversion events to the main app, and work with product engineering on tracking integrations

Requirements

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, comfortable working in both frontend code and a production application codebase

  • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server-side GTM, and at least one conversion API (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or similar) implemented server-to-server

  • Experience debugging attribution discrepancies end to end: pixel vs server deduplication, UTM conventions, event schema design

  • Solid understanding of web performance and how to add tracking without degrading Core Web Vitals

  • Working knowledge of consent and privacy requirements (Consent Mode v2, regional restrictions) and SQL for validating tracking data in the warehouse

Bonus

  • CDP experience (Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow)

  • Product analytics tools (GA4, Amplitude, PostHog) and dbt

  • Next.js experience

  • Exposure to incrementality testing or media mix modelling

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own the whole martech and measurement area as it grows, potentially leading a small marketing engineering team

  • Grow toward senior/staff IC on the engineering track

  • Broaden into data engineering and attribution modelling, or into growth engineering more widely (experimentation, landing page infrastructure)

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.


#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

You will add and improve tracking scripts without hurting pagespeed, keep our server-side GTM container healthy, make sure consent and regional restrictions are correctly enforced, and ensure the right channels get credit for the right conversions. Your work directly decides how a large paid budget gets allocated.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own our tag manager setup end to end, including the server-side GTM container, and review any changes other teams want to make

 - Work with the paid marketing team daily: fix tracking bugs, set up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debug discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data

 - Build and maintain server-to-server conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, and similar) and validate pixel vs server deduplication

 - Improve tracking script performance and correctness, keeping script impact on pagespeed and Core Web Vitals within budget

 - Make sure consent handling and regional restrictions are correctly enforced across markets

 - Define event schema and UTM conventions, and document them so tracking for new campaigns is correct by default

 - Build monitoring and alerting for the measurement stack so we catch broken tracking within hours, not weeks

 - Review PRs that add conversion events to the main app, and work with product engineering on tracking integrations




REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, comfortable working in both frontend code and a production application codebase

 - Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server-side GTM, and at least one conversion API (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or similar) implemented server-to-server

 - Experience debugging attribution discrepancies end to end: pixel vs server deduplication, UTM conventions, event schema design

 - Solid understanding of web performance and how to add tracking without degrading Core Web Vitals

 - Working knowledge of consent and privacy requirements (Consent Mode v2, regional restrictions) and SQL for validating tracking data in the warehouse




BONUS

 - CDP experience (Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow)

 - Product analytics tools (GA4, Amplitude, PostHog) and dbt

 - Next.js experience

 - Exposure to incrementality testing or media mix modelling




GROWTH POTENTIAL

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

 - Own the whole martech and measurement area as it grows, potentially leading a small marketing engineering team

 - Grow toward senior/staff IC on the engineering track

 - Broaden into data engineering and attribution modelling, or into growth engineering more widely (experimentation, landing page infrastructure)




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.




#LI-Remote

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will:

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

  • Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

  • Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

  • Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

  • Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

  • Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy.

  • Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

  • Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

  • Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are:

  • You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

  • You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

  • You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

  • You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring:

Primary requirements

  • 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

  • A wide, current network of contacts across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Prior government or grands corps experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong.

  • Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

  • Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus.

Also required

  • Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

  • Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

  • Public policy experience across France.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

  • Fluency in English and French.

Location

This role is located in France.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll work as part of a driven team to unlock the full potential of our voice AI platform for a growing customer base. Your mission is to efficiently scale our technical solutions to many enterprise customers, both directly and by improving our internal processes and supporting our sales teams.

As a Solutions Engineer, you can expect to:

  • Collaborate strategically with Account Executives to enhance the technical aspects of the sales process.

  • Work directly with technical contacts from our customers and prospective customers to provide bespoke support and architect solutions.

  • Craft compelling technical demonstrations that clearly communicate our product's value proposition.

  • Create technical enablement resources that amplify our sales team's effectiveness and technical fluency.

  • Build self-service tools and documentation that empower customers to implement solutions independently.

  • Identify opportunities to productize common integration patterns or features, and work with our product teams to make these real!

Requirements

We're looking for exceptional individuals who excel at working with customers on technical problems and excited to work with us to scale this efficiently. You'll thrive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

  • Enjoy working directly with customers, iterating on solutions and providing tailored support

  • Have a talent for identifying patterns that can be standardized and scaled.

  • Have strong empathy for customers, sales and product teams.

  • Have a strong technical background in order to help customers architect integration between our solutions and their existing solutions

  • Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

  • Proficiency in Python, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and common integration patterns.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Canada, however there is a preference for candidates to be based out of Toronto. Expect regular travel for customer onsites.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate.

You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them.

 

No two days are the same, but you should expect to:

  • Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points.

  • Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region.

  • Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions.

  • Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations.

  • Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness.

  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

  • Collaborate with our Research and Product teams to incorporate field insights into ElevenLabs' software products and AI models.

  • Build and deliver compelling demos of our voice and audio AI technology to new and existing customers.

  • Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Collaborate daily with our customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure optimal implementation of ElevenLabs' technologies.

 

Requirements

  • Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging and influencing C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, both internally and at customer or partner organizations.

  • People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams while fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.

  • Basic proficiency in Python and understanding of API integration to implement scripts and help with prototyping/demo building.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical concepts and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

  • Technical aptitude to quickly understand our voice and audio AI models and their applications.

  • Strategic and Commercial Awareness: Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives, with an understanding of deal structures, go-to-market motions, and revenue impact.

  • Nice to have: Partner Ecosystem Development - Experience identifying, building, and nurturing relationships with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to drive market growth.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Saudi Arabia or UAE. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Arabic and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Field marketing is at the heart of how we build demand, foster community, deepen customer relationships, and accelerate growth. We are looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Field Marketing Manager to build the engine that fills the funnel for our North America GTM team, focused on two to three priority industries: healthcare, financial services, telco, and retail and e-commerce.

Your expertise in industry-led field marketing strategy, regional program execution, and GTM partnership will be pivotal in creating the moments that bring enterprise buyers to the table, from executive dinners and roadshows to industry conferences, roundtables, and account-based programs aimed at named buying committees. Collaborating closely with the North America GTM team and the broader marketing team, you will own every stage of the field motion, from territory and account strategy through budgeting, on-site execution, and post-program pipeline attribution.

ElevenAgents is being evaluated today by customer experience and contact center leaders at the largest health systems, banks, carriers, and retailers in North America. Your ability to think like a marketer, act like a salesperson, and run multiple industry programs at once will ensure we get in front of them first.

What you’ll do

  • Build the engine that fills the funnel for your industries, a repeatable program mix that creates net new pipeline quarter over quarter

  • Develop and execute the North America field plan for two to three industries, from territory and account strategy through budget, execution, and attribution

  • Partner with Enterprise and Strategic account executives on named account lists. Agree the targets, fill the room, drive the follow-up.

  • Design the program mix: executive dinners, industry conferences, roadshows, roundtables, customer advisory sessions, and 1:few account-based plays

  • Create the vertical narrative with Product Marketing. Invite copy, talk tracks, and follow-up sequences that speak to a healthcare, banking, telco, or retail buyer, not a generic one.

  • Manage event budgets and timelines, and report pipeline created and cost per opportunity, program by program

  • Analyze program performance in Salesforce and Dream Data and give an honest read on what worked. Recommend what to scale and what to retire.

  • Follow up with participants in collaboration with the GTM and growth teams

  • Work with Paid Media and Demand Generation to amplify field programs before and after they run

  • Own end to end execution, with support from the North America events team on venue, vendors, logistics, and on-site delivery

Requirements

We are more focused on hiring for potential than past experience, but the person who thrives here will bring most of the following.

  • 7+ years in B2B field, industry, or regional marketing, with a demonstrated track record of building programs that directly influenced pipeline and closed revenue

  • Deep experience marketing into at least two of: healthcare, financial services, telco, retail and e-commerce

  • Track record reaching enterprise buying committees on six and seven figure deals

  • Fluency in Salesforce and marketing attribution. You can defend your numbers in a pipeline review.

  • A peer relationship with GTM. You have pushed back on an account executive and been right.

  • Comfortable running an executive dinner, speaking at events, and partnering with C-level stakeholders inside and outside the company

  • Sharp judgment on what to cut. Budget and calendar discipline under tight deadlines.

  • Willing to travel roughly a third of the time across North America

  • Transparent and unafraid to challenge, ask questions, or call out obstacles

  • An AI-first working style, and a passion for ElevenLabs technology

  • Bias toward shipping

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate.

You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them.

No two days are the same, but you should expect to:

  • Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points.

  • Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region.

  • Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions.

  • Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations.

  • Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness.

  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

  • Collaborate with our Research and Product teams to incorporate field insights into ElevenLabs' software products and AI models.

  • Build and deliver compelling demos of our voice and audio AI technology to new and existing customers.

  • Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Collaborate daily with our customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure optimal implementation of ElevenLabs' technologies.

Requirements

  • Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging and influencing C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, both internally and at customer or partner organizations.

  • People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams while fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.

  • Basic proficiency in Python and understanding of API integration to implement scripts and help with prototyping/demo building.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical concepts and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

  • Technical aptitude to quickly understand our voice and audio AI models and their applications.

  • Strategic and Commercial Awareness: Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives, with an understanding of deal structures, go-to-market motions, and revenue impact.

  • Nice to have: Partner Ecosystem Development - Experience identifying, building, and nurturing relationships with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to drive market growth.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in India, with a preference of Bangalore. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Bonus: You enjoy attending, speaking and engaging at developer conferences.
